cohort: 533 women aged 18+ with type 1 diabetes diagnosed before conception, who were either currently pregnant or had given birth in the preceding 10 years
finding: Women with type 1 diabetes who planned their pregnancies had lower HbA1c at conception and were at lower risk of cesarean birth, excess weight gain, hypoglycemia, and preeclampsia.
mod_finding: Women with higher HbA1c at conception were at a higher risk for cesarean birth.
